title: Mathlib descent of local finite type and formal unramifiedness along one fpqc morphism
statement: Let f: X -> S and g: T -> S be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with g surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Each of the two properties P = locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and P = formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism] descends along g: for any fibre product square [def-pc-fibre-product] with second projection f_T, P(f_T) implies P(f). These are separate descent assertions; neither assumes the other property.

source.place: instances at lines 35-36 and 44-45; HasRingHomProperty.descendsAlong_flat applied to RingHom.FiniteType.codescendsAlong_faithfullyFlat and RingHom.FormallyUnramified.codescendsAlong_faithfullyFlat

proof.text: For each property use its ring-hom characterization and Zariski locality to reduce to affine schemes. A flat surjective map of affine schemes induces a faithfully flat ring map. RingHom.FiniteType.codescendsAlong_faithfullyFlat gives finite-type descent; RingHom.FormallyUnramified.codescendsAlong_faithfullyFlat gives formal-unramified descent. HasRingHomProperty.descendsAlong_flat performs the affine-to-scheme passage for each property. These are the two existing instances of Mathlib LocalFlatDescent.
